title: Growth Marketer (m/w/d) Meta Ads für E-Commerce | Boutique-Agentur, Online Marketing
description: Growth Marketer heißt bei uns nicht „ein bisschen von allem". Es heißt: Du treibst unser Wachstum – mit Meta Ads als Fundament. Meta ist der Kanal, der heute das Volumen trägt, und er gehört dir: Kampagnenarchitektur, Budget, Creative-Testing, Ergebnis. Dabei bleibt es aber nicht. Influencer und weitere Wachstumskanäle stehen bei uns nicht auf einer Wunschliste, sondern auf der Roadmap – und du baust sie mit auf. Was wir nicht suchen: den Bauchladen, der fünf Plattformen halb bespielt und überall Mittelmaß liefert. Wir suchen jemanden, der Meta auf Weltklasse-Niveau beherrscht und von dieser Basis aus den nächsten Kanal ernsthaft aufbaut – statt von einem zum nächsten zu springen. Zweiter Punkt, bevor du weiterliest: Wir arbeiten AI-nativ. Das schreibt inzwischen jeder, deshalb konkret: Wir bauen eigene AI-Werkzeuge. MCP-Anbindung an unsere Ad-Accounts, automatisierte Audits, Anomalie-Erkennung, eigene Skills für Angle- und Skript-Entwicklung. AI ist bei uns Standard-Werkzeug, nicht Notnagel. Wer 2026 noch jede Analyse von Hand baut, ist uns zu langsam. Wer umgekehrt jede Entscheidung an die AI abgibt, liefert denselben Output wie jeder Wettbewerber mit demselben Modell. Wir suchen die Mitte: Du steuerst, AI beschleunigt. Wenn dich beides anzieht – Tiefe statt Bauchladen, AI als Hebel statt als Ersatz fürs Denken – lies weiter. Wer wir sind SKINBRO ist eine schnell wachsende Männerpflege-Marke aus Hamburg: feste Seifen, feste Shampoos, Deos und Parfums – natürlich, plastikfrei, Made in Germany. Wir verkaufen über Shopify, Amazon und TikTok Shop und wachsen im DACH-Raum weiter. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen. Wenn du feststellst, dass nicht die Ads das Problem sind, sondern das Offer, das Bundle, der Preis oder die Landingpage: Das wird bei uns entschieden, nicht anderswo. Du musst niemanden überzeugen, der weit weg sitzt – du bringst es in den nächsten Call ein, und wenn deine Analyse überzeugt, wird es geändert. Was das für die Rolle heißt: Bei uns sinkt manchmal der ROAS im Werbeanzeigenmanager, während das Geschäft wächst. Und das ist dann genau richtig. Wer in Tages-ROAS denkt, wird bei uns unglücklich. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben Du führst unser Wachstum auf Meta – von Audit über Hypothese und Test-Roadmap bis Skalierung und Reporting. Strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust unsere weiteren Wachstumskanäle mit aus, Influencer voran: Welcher Kanal verdient das nächste Budget, was lässt sich aus den Meta-Learnings übertragen, wo endet ein Test und wo beginnt ein Kanal? Du steuerst nach Total Business Numbers (Net Revenue, CAC, Deckungsbeitrag, MER) und inkrementellen KPIs, nicht nach Plattform-ROAS allein. Du denkst über die Anzeige hinaus: Wenn der Wachstums-Bottleneck nicht in den Ads liegt (Offer, Landingpage, Produkt, Pricing), sagst du es klar und lieferst einen Alternativweg. Du machst die Customer Journey messbar: Micro-Conversions als Algo-Futter, Post-Purchase-Surveys, saubere Attributionslogik statt Bauchgefühl. Du baust deine Test-Roadmaps mit AI-Unterstützung. Unser Stack liefert dir Audits, Breakdowns und Anomalie-Signale; du lieferst die Hypothese und prüfst den Output, statt ihn blind zu übernehmen. Du entwickelst Wachstums-Hypothesen (Segment → Mechanismus → fehlendes Set-Piece) und liest Creative-Performance jenseits der Vanity-Metriken. Qualifikation Dein Profil Du hast Meta Ads operativ und strategisch im Griff – Kampagnenarchitektur, Optimierungsziele, Creative-Testing – und kannst deine Entscheidungen einem Founder in Geschäftszahlen erklären. Du denkst in Systemen: Hypothese → Test → Learning → nächster Test. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI – eigene Prompts und Workflows, idealerweise schon mal Tool-Anbindungen oder Automatisierungen genutzt – und kannst konkret erzählen, wo AI dich schneller gemacht hat und wo du ihr bewusst nicht vertraust. Du verstehst Inkrementalität (New-Customer-Steuerung) und warum Last-Click täuscht. Oder du willst genau das in den ersten 90 Tagen bei uns lernen und belegen. Du bist konfrontationsfähig: Du nickst „morgen 5x skalieren" nicht ab, sondern hältst dagegen – auch gegenüber der Geschäftsführung. Benefits Was wir bieten Ein Umfeld, in dem AI-Werkzeuge nicht beantragt, sondern gebaut werden. Eine Marke statt zehn Accounts. Du optimierst nicht Kampagnen für fremde Unternehmen, sondern baust ein Geschäft, das dir jeden Tag zurückspiegelt, was deine Entscheidungen bewirkt haben. Echte Hebel: Offer, Bundle, Preis, Landingpage, Produkt – alles im Haus, alles verhandelbar, wenn deine Analyse überzeugt. Ein herausforderndes und anspruchsvolles Arbeitsumfeld, das stets im Wandel ist und deiner Arbeit Wertschätzung zollt. Kompetitives Gehalt, basierend auf deiner Performance. Eine lockere Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und jeder Menge Spaß, ohne dass die Professionalität verloren geht. Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist: Die Rolle ist vollständig remote, mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. Ausstattung mit den neusten Apple-Produkten. So läuft die Bewerbung Kurzbewerbung – im Anschluss an die Profilsichtung: ein paar Rückfragen per E-Mail oder Telefon. 2 × Gespräche – 1× mit der Geschäftsführung, 1× mit einem Team-Member. Überprüfung der fachlichen und persönlichen Eignung. Kompakte Probearbeit an einem realen Szenario aus unserem Account. AI-Einsatz ist dabei ausdrücklich erlaubt und erwünscht – uns interessiert, wo du sie einsetzt und wo bewusst nicht. Du erkennst dich wieder? Dann bewirb dich. Du unterstützt Partner und Kunden bei der Migration ihrer SAP-Business-One-Systeme in die Cloud. Du bist Ansprechpartner für Kunden während der Migration und erklärst auch komplexe technische Themen verständlich. Interesse an neuen Technologien und Lust, dich in Themen wie Cloud, KI und moderne SAP-Business-One-Architekturen einzuarbeiten. Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Teamgeist und Spaß daran, Neues auszuprobieren. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Uns ist wichtiger, dass du neugierig bist und dich weiterentwickeln möchtest, als dass du bereits jede Technologie beherrschst. You will contribute to critical data initiatives by creating reusable, business-aligned data assets that address complex business challenges. Your work will directly support enterprise data strategies and the implementation of modern, automated data solutions.

You will work closely with client teams to ensure data model consistency, quality, and alignment with enterprise architecture and strategic priorities.

By joining Visium, you will work alongside experts in modern data platforms, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI specialists. Our focus is on enabling customers to make their AI use cases enterprise-ready. Since the quality and preparation of data are crucial for AI success, your role will ultimately empower customers to be ready for an AI-driven future.

  • Translate complex business needs into robust models (focus Data Vault 2.0), including conceptual, logical, and physical layers.
  • Design and implement scalable, auditable data products using Data Vault patterns.
  • Ensure modeling consistency and alignment with enterprise standards, especially across multiple data domains and delivery teams.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders and data teams to clarify requirements, define model scope, and align on delivery timelines.
  • Integrate models with modern data platforms with state-of-the-art toolchains (CI/CD, Git)

  • A position that enables you to have an impact on 1’000s of people, and the whole company's growth.

Senior Software Engineer - Identity & Agent Protocols (f/m/d)

Cologne (hybrid) or Berlin (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time) 

We're building the trust layer for agentic & human commerce: a Trust Authority that issues and verifies credentials for AI agents acting on behalf of consumers and shops. The protocol, the APIs and the UI - you would be a core engineer on it.

Your Key Responsibilities as a Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d):

  • Design and build the APIs and services behind our Trust Authority - credential issuance, verification, refresh and revocation.

  • Develop cross‑platform Web Components

  • Work with open identity standards such as OAuth2 / OIDC, passkeys, Verifiable Credentials, did:web, Web Bot Auth

  • Own the system design - service boundaries, data models, API contracts - and make the calls that others build on.

  • Build and run it on AWS with Terraform (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, KMS), including monitoring and alerting.

  • Ingest and analyse agent traffic, and turn raw signals into something we can act on.

  • Own our automated testing: build the end-to-end, contract and visual regression suites in CI (Playwright) from scratch, so we release without manual regression checking.

  • Take features from unclear idea to production and keep them healthy.


  • Strong backend engineering, ideally in Node.js / TypeScript. Depth matters more to us than the specific language - part of our stack is Java (Keycloak).

  • Frontend experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.

  • Real API and system design experience: you've designed APIs other teams depend on, and you can explain your trade-offs.

  • Hands-on AWS and infrastructure as code (Terraform). You deploy your own changes.

  • Solid security fundamentals: OAuth2 / OIDC, secure API design, and the basics of signing and key management.

  • You've built automated test suites others rely on, not just tests alongside your own features. Hands-on with a modern E2E framework such as Playwright or Cypress.

  • You're comfortable when the answer isn't known yet, and you decide with incomplete information.

  • Verifiable Credentials, DIDs, WebAuthn / passkeys, or HTTP message signatures.

  • Workation: Temporarily work from a destination of your choice within EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway

  • 28 vacation days

  • 2.5 additional days off at Christmas, New Year's Eve and Carnival

  • Events (Team Events, Unit Events, etc.)

Deine Einarbeitung

Warum IRIS?

Wir glauben, dass gute IT dort entsteht, wo Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam Lösungen entwickeln.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Berlin I Germany, EMEA I Remote
description: How will you make an impact? As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You'll ship features that solve real customer problems, contribute to our CMS core, extend our platform capabilities, and help bring AI-powered features to life. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. You'll use your judgment, collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and customers, and move fast using modern AI-assisted development tools. This role is for someone who sees engineering as a team sport, takes ownership without waiting for permission, and thrives in an environment where initiative matters more than instructions. What you will be working on: Core CMS development: Evolve the GraphQL-native CMS powering enterprise teams worldwide, improving performance, reliability, and developer experience. CMS extensions and integrations: Develop and maintain extensions that expand what customers can do with Hygraph. AI-powered features: Contribute to our AI roadmap by building intelligent capabilities into the product. Customer-facing improvements: Use monitoring data, customer feedback, and your product instinct to identify and fix problems before they're reported proactively. Some of your tasks and responsibilities: Collaborate in a cross-functional, autonomous team to deliver features and continuous improvements, often working from rough prototypes or early concepts rather than polished designs. Translate business needs into technical solutions by working closely with the Product team. Occasionally, participate in customer conversations to validate that what you're building actually solves their problems. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, or similar) to accelerate development. Proactively identify issues through monitoring and observability data. Then fix them, don't just flag them. Contribute to architectural decisions that keep our platform scalable, reliable, and maintainable. Share what you know, learn from others, and help your teammates grow. Engineering here is collaborative. We win together. Expectations timeline 1 Month You'll complete onboarding covering our product, tech stack, infrastructure, and vision. You'll meet people across the company, get familiar with our codebase, and ship your first contributions. You'll start building context on how our customers use Hygraph and what matters most to them. 3 Months You'll be delivering features and improvements to production with confidence. You'll have a solid understanding of Hygraph's product and architecture, and you'll be contributing ideas, not just code. You'll have built working relationships with your team lead, PMs, designers, and fellow engineers through regular 1:1s, operational reviews, and day-to-day collaboration. 6 Months By now, you'll be making significant contributions to both the product and the team. You'll bring fresh perspectives from your experience and help raise the bar across performance, architecture, and how we work. You'll be someone the team relies on. Not because you do everything, but because you make everyone around you better. What we expect from you: Significant experience (typically 6+ years) building and owning production systems, with strong full-stack skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and deep backend expertise, scalability, and performance fundamentals (ideally Node.js ). Experience building user interfaces, ideally with React. Experience developing well-tested APIs with GraphQL. Solid knowledge of relational databases (especially PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization. Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in your workflow. Familiarity with cloud-native development (AWS, GCP). Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (New Relic, Datadog, or similar). Openness and experience with on-call and operational work (investigations, incident response, etc.). Ability to work with ambiguity: rough prototypes, evolving requirements, and imperfect information. You use judgment and experience to fill the gaps. Strong product sense. You think about why you're building something, not just how. You care about the customer experience, not just the code. Bonus points Experience with Golang. Knowledge of infrastructure as code tooling (Pulumi, Terraform). Experience working directly with customers or in customer-facing roles. Familiarity with headless CMS platforms or content infrastructure. The Process Intro call with People Team Interview with the Hiring Manager Technical Interview C-Level Call and Reference Check (optional) Job Offer The response time after application, screening applications, and setting up the first intro call is usually within 1-2 weeks. You could expect some alterations when necessary. About us Hygraph is a dynamic Berlin-based startup and a GraphQL-native, API-first headless CMS built for teams delivering complex, composable digital experiences. Hygraph is on a mission to eliminate complexity for global teams and help them scale content without friction. Our platform empowers you to create, deliver, and distribute content faster and at scale. We’re a team committed to shaping the future of AI-powered content platforms. Trusted by over 50,000 teams worldwide, Hygraph powers structured content across websites, applications, product experiences, and AI-enabled systems. As AI reshapes how digital experiences are created and operated, Hygraph is helping organizations build on structured, trusted content foundations that enable human-first, AI-accelerated experiences at scale. You will be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team committed to working collaboratively, transparently, and passionately. We believe in a remote-first approach where everyone is encouraged to do their best from wherever they are and work together with transparency, accountability, and ownership. We learn continuously through feedback and have a yearly learning budget to attend training and conferences. Hygraph is an equal-opportunity employer committed to hiring people with diverse backgrounds. We believe that diversity, unique experiences, qualities, and different cultures enrich our workspace's productivity and promote innovation and creativity. Note: We are fortunate to receive a large number of applications for our roles. To manage this effectively and give each application the attention it deserves, we use AI-assisted tools to help assess certain screening questions and handle application elements. This helps us ensure a consistent and timely review process. All final hiring decisions are made exclusively by our human recruitment team. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Das gibt es zu tun:

Unsere Kunden sind Geschäftsführer, die fundierte Entscheidungen treffen. Unser Ziel ist nicht Reichweite, sondern Relevanz. Content-Erstellung & Publishing

Schreiben von:

  • Short‑form: LinkedIn‑Posts (gern mit Humor), Newsletter‑Teaser, Micro‑Copy für CTAs
  • Umsetzung der Ergebnisse in WordPress inkl. interner Verlinkung, strukturierten Daten (Schema.org), Medienhandling
  • Außergewöhnliche & out of the box-Kampagnen

SEO & GEO

  • Intent‑ & Keyword‑Modellierung, semantische Struktur (Entitäten, Co‑Occurrences), interne Linklogik

  • LLM‑/GEO‑Tauglichkeit (Generative Engine Optimization): klare Definitionen, Q&A‑Module, konsistente Terminologie, Quellenbelege
  • Distribution & Kampagnen
  • Orchestrierung über LinkedIn (Company & Personal Brand), Newsletter (ActiveCampaign), Leadmagnete
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb (Content als Sales‑Enablement)

  • GA4, GSC, eTracker/Hotjar: Dashboards, Learnings und Maßnahmen ableiten; monatliches Reporting

Website & LinkedIn

  • Pflege und Erweiterung unserer Website
  • Erstellung von Landingpages & Download-Seiten
  • Redaktionelle Betreuung unseres LinkedIn-Unternehmensprofils
    (fachlich, kompetent, ohne Marketing-Floskeln)

Allgemein

  • Unterstützung bei Messeorganisation & Vorbereitungen
  • Idealerweise inkl. Unterlagen, Design von Flyern, Broschüren, etc.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Mindestens 4+ Jahre B2B‑Content in erklärungsbedürftigen Themen (SaaS/IT/Industrie) mit Arbeitsproben
  • Nachweislich Inhalte konzipiert & geschrieben, die Leads vorbereitet oder Sales unterstützt haben
  • SEO/GEO‑Fitness: semantische Cluster, Entitäten/FAQs, interne Verlinkung, Schema.org; Tools wie Ahrefs/Semrush/Sistrix
  • Sicher in WordPress & grundlegenden MarTech‑Flows (ActiveCampaign/Newsletter, UTM/Tracking‑Basics)
  • Analytics‑Kompetenz (GA4, GSC, eTracker/Hotjar) und Freude an Ergebnis‑/KPI‑Denke
  • Stilbreite von fachlich seriös bis sympathisch‑locker; Humor, der zur Zielgruppe passt
  • Eigenständige Arbeitsweise, klare Priorisierung, kurze Status‑Updates – „Outcome vor Aktivität“

Nice-to-have

  • Branchenverständnis (technische Dienstleister, Handel) oder nachweisbar schnelle Einarbeitung
  • Leichte Grafikskills (Canva), Erfahrung im Case‑Interviewing

Benefits

Zwischen 20-30 Wochenstunden

Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Option, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten (hybrid)

Faire Bezahlung im Mittelstandskorridor

Viel Gestaltungsspielraum & hohe Ownership

title: CRM Manager (m/w/d) - Vor Ort/Home-Office
description: Wir bei Inkster schreiben Eigenverantwortlichkeit, Motivation und Spaß groß! Als 10-köpfiges Team aus Digital Natives und unserem einzigartigen 2-Wochen Tattoo auf Fruchtbasis sind wir im Juni 2021 gestartet und innerhalb weniger Monate zum Europamarktführer aufgestiegen. Heute verkaufen wir unsere Produkte in sechs internationalen Märkten und arbeiten täglich daran, Inkster als moderne Love-Brand weiter auszubauen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine/n CRM Managerin:in. Du begeisterst dich für Customer Experience, CRM und datengetriebenes Marketing? Gleichzeitig hast du Spaß daran, kreative Kampagnen, Newsletter und neue Ideen zu entwickeln? In dieser Rolle verbindest du analytisches Denken mit kreativem Arbeiten: Du analysierst Daten, verstehst unsere Kund:innen und entwickelst daraus Maßnahmen, die unsere Customer Journey, Kundenbindung und Kundenzufriedenheit nachhaltig verbessern. Von E-Mail-Marketing über Automatisierungen gestaltest du das gesamte Erlebnis unserer Bestandskund:innen aktiv mit. Du wirst als Vollzeitkraft ein wichtiger Teil unseres Teams, arbeitest eng mit den Foundern zusammen und erhältst viel Verantwortung ab Tag 1. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir unsere Kundenkommunikation kontinuierlich weiter, optimieren die Customer Experience und bauen Inkster als internationale Love-Brand weiter aus. Wir freuen uns auf dich. Aufgaben Du planst, erstellst und optimierst kreative E-Mail- und SMS-Kampagnen entlang der gesamten Customer Journey. Du entwickelst neue Automationen und Customer Flows, wertest deren Performance aus und optimierst sie kontinuierlich anhand relevanter KPIs. Du analysierst das Verhalten unserer Kund:innen und leitest daraus neue Ideen für CRM-Kampagnen, Customer Journeys und Retention-Maßnahmen ab. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit unserem Customer Support die Qualität unserer Kundenkommunikation und stellst sicher, dass unsere Support Agents und AI-Systeme jederzeit auf dem neuesten Stand sind. Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Kundenanliegen und entwickelst Prozesse, Inhalte und Lösungen, um die Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du analysierst Kennzahlen wie Wiederkaufrate, Customer Lifetime Value, Trustpilot-Bewertungen und Kundenzufriedenheit und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, Design, Content und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bringst Kundenfeedback in neue Kampagnen, Produkte und Prozesse ein. Qualifikation Du hast Erfahrung im CRM-, Customer Experience-, Customer Success- oder E-Mail-Marketing – idealerweise im E-Commerce oder bei einer D2C-Brand. Du kombinierst analytisches Denken mit Kreativität und findest sowohl in Zahlen als auch in der Kommunikation Optimierungspotenziale. Du hast ein starkes Gespür für modernes Design, Ästhetik, Branding und visuelle Kommunikation. Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis für Customer Journeys und weißt, wie man Kund:innen langfristig begeistert und bindet. Idealerweise hast du bereits mit CRM-Tools wie Klaviyo (Photoshop, Canva, o.ä.) sowie Helpdesk-Lösungen wie Gorgias, Zendesk oder ähnlichen Systemen gearbeitet. Du arbeitest organisiert, eigenverantwortlich und pragmatisch und setzt Projekte zuverlässig um. Du hast Freude daran, Prozesse zu verbessern, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und moderne KI-Tools sinnvoll einzusetzen. Du besitzt sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Was prettyTELCO von anderen Personalvermittlungen abhebt, ist unser Fokus auf die Vermittlung von Menschen, die nicht nur fachlich qualifiziert sind, sondern auch menschlich perfekt ins Unternehmen passen. 🤝🏻

Wir agieren deutschlandweit innerhalb der Telekommunikationsbranche und legen großen Wert auf einen persönlichen Ansatz. Wir nehmen uns Zeit, sowohl Unternehmen als auch Kandidaten kennenzulernen, um deren Wünsche und Anforderungen genau zu verstehen. Denn bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt – niemand ist nur eine Nummer bei uns! 🚀

Aufgaben

  • Du berätst und betreust unsere Geschäftskunden ganzheitlich bei allen technischen Herausforderungen im Umfeld krisensicherer M2M Kommunikation u.a. Smart Grid und Smart Metering
  • Du bin erster technischer Ansprechpartner und managst die Kundenprojekte von der Presales-Beratung über das Technical Onboarding und die Pilotierung bis hin zur stabilen Inbetriebnahme und Erweiterung.
  • Du unterstützt den Vertrieb im Presales durch technische Beratung, Konzeptionierung und Präsentationen beim Kunden
  • Du bearbeitest technische Fragestellungen Ihrer Kunden und übernimmst die strukturierte Fehleranalyse sowie nachhaltige Problemlösung im Testing und im laufenden Betrieb.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Vertrieb, Kundenservice, Produktmanagement und technischen Fachabteilungen zusammen.
  • Du bringst Kundenanforderungen strukturiert in die Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Services ein.

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Ende-zu-Ende-Anwendung von IT- und Mobilfunktechnologien für die Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation (M2M).
  • Du bringst Erfahrung insbesondere in den Bereichen Smart Grid und Smart Metering mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Beratung komplexer ITK-Lösungen im B2B-Umfeld.
  • Du besitzt sehr gute Kenntnisse moderner Mobilfunktechnologien sowie sicherer IT-Kommunikationswege.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im IP-Management sowie mit sicheren Anbindungen, z. B. über LWL-basierte Netze, APN-Strukturen und API-Gateways.
  • Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und bringen eine hohe Eigeninitiative mit.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.
  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Projektmanagement mit und arbeitest sicher in projektorientierten Strukturen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung, z. B. im Bereich Elektro-, Nachrichten- oder Informationstechnik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie über mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung.

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Anstellungsvertrag
  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket, inkl. monatlichem steuer- und SV-freier Fahrtkostenzuschuss in Höhe von 50,00€
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20% Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und regelmäßige Schulungen
  • Kollegiales Umfeld, kurze Entscheidungswege und offene Kommunikation
  • Abwechslungsreiches Aufgabenspektrum und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens
  • Modernes Büro mit höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Klimaanlage, barrierefreie Räumlichkeiten
  • Erstklassige überregionale und regionale Verkehrsanbindung sowie kostenlose Mitarbeiter-Parkplätze (einschließlich kostenpflichtiger E-Ladestationen eines Drittanbieters)
  • Technische Ausstattung (Notebook, Docking Station, Bildschirm, Mobiltelefon)

Wir freuen uns auf Dich und Deine Bewerbung! 🤩

raw.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

the market.</p> <p>In the role, you will:</p> <p><strong>Build and scale a best-in-class fulfillment network (strategy + execution)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and optimize the full Parcels logistics value chain: inbound to warehouse, repack/kitting, inventory management, pick/pack, carrier handoff, last-mile delivery, and returns/claims.</li> <li>Architect and execute a logistics and fulfillment strategy that supports cost efficiency, service quality, and international growth.</li> <li>Operate comfortably in ambiguity: create structure fast, make trade-offs, and iterate as we scale.</li> write-offs, and improve inventory turns.</li> <li>Build dashboards and operating rhythms that create transparency and decision speed across markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead teams and cross-functional execution in a matrix</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a global logistics organization; set clear priorities, empower local leaders, and raise the operational bar across markets.</li> <li>Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Projects/CI, and local Operations teams to execute against business goals.</li> <li>Lead complex cross-functional initiatives (e.g., carrier transitions, new country launches, peak readiness, system implementation, process changes).</li> </ul> <p>What success looks like for this role:</p> <ul> <li>A scalable, repeatable fulfillment model that behaves like a modern e-commerce operation: reliable delivery, strong unit economics, and operational control.</li> <li>Strong partner performance and accountability: clear SLAs, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Define and implement service metrics (e.g., on-time delivery, refunds, delivery quality) while driving down cost-to-serve.</li> <li>Inventory health and planning maturity: fewer write-offs, fewer surprises, faster decision cycles.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>What is required for this role:</p> <ul> <li>Experience in senior logistics / fulfillment leadership (or similar), ideally in e-commerce, food delivery, meal kits, retail, or food/CPG supply chain.</li> <li>Proven experience building and managing multi-country logistics operations with multiple 3PLs and carrier partners.</li> <li>Strong track record in warehouse process design and optimization (directly or through 3PLs): pick/pack, repack/kitting, layout, capacity planning.</li> <li>Experience with cross-border and pan-European parcel networks is a strong advantage.</li> <li>Experience in a global matrix organization is a plus.</li> <li>Strong analytical capability (KPIs, dashboards, root-cause problem solving) and planning discipline (S&amp;OP, capacity, inventory).</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management—able to align teams, challenge constructively, and drive decisions.</li> </ul> <p>You’ll succeed in this role if you are:</p> <ul> <li>A strategic operator: you can design the system and also roll up your sleeves to make it work day to day.</li> <li>Comfortable moving fast: you can deliver outcomes in an agile, iterative environment without waiting for perfect information.</li> <li>Commercially sharp: you understand unit economics, contract levers, and how to scale with partners without losing control.</li> <li>Calm under pressure: you can handle peak periods, partner incidents, and operational fire-fighting while still improving the system.</li> </ul> <p>Our values:</p> <ul> <li>We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. raw.title: Practice Director
raw.description:
Salary up to £65,000 DOE

 
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

Fyrnwy Equine Hospital is a well-established 18 vet practice with a Tier 3 equine hospital and ambulatory branch, covering Shropshire, Cheshire and North Wales. The practice consists of European boarded specialists in surgery and medicine, as well as 2 equine nurses, 1 student vet nurse and 11 support staff members. As a practice we manage a mix of National Hunt Thoroughbred studs and Sports horse clients as well as some individual breeders.
 
 
How You’ll Make a Difference 
 
 
As Director of Practice, you will have overall accountability for the performance, strategy, and culture of one or more veterinary practices or hospitals, balancing clinical excellence with strong operational and commercial outcomes. 
 
You’ll lead both clinical and non-clinical teams, set the strategic direction of the practice(s), and ensure the delivery of outstanding patient and client care alongside sustainable business performance. Working closely with regional and group leadership, you’ll drive continuous improvement across clinical standards, people development, financial performance, and ways of working. 
 
*Lead the creation and delivery of the annual business plan, driving sustainable growth while engaging the wider team to contribute ideas, provide feedback, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
*Monitor, analyse, and communicate both practice and individual performance, actively sharing best practice and contributing to the overall success of the wider area.
*Ensure outstanding clinical outcomes by maintaining full compliance with regulatory and governance requirements, while promoting and embedding high clinical standards across all sites.
*Foster a culture of continuous improvement through regular development discussions, performance management, and ongoing team support.
*Champion an exceptional client experience by driving client engagement, promoting service excellence, and ensuring high standards are delivered consistently in every interaction.
*Build and maintain an engaged, high-performing team culture, ensuring appropriate resourcing, supporting staff development, and maintaining a safe, compliant working environment.
*Take full accountability for the financial performance of the practice, including management of the P&L, delivering against budgets, and meeting all financial management requirements .
*Role is full time 40 hours per week - 5 days over 7
 
You Might Be a Great Fit If... 
 
 
You are a highly experienced veterinary leader with strong clinical credibility and proven operational and strategic leadership capability. You’ll bring: 
 
* Proven leadership experience with accountability for clinical, operational, and commercial performance 
* Strong financial and operational understanding, including experience with business planning and P&L management 
* The ability to lead, develop, and inspire multidisciplinary teams through change and growth 
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills 
 
 
How We’ll Support You 
 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting you in a senior leadership role. When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
 
* Overall leadership of one or more practices or hospitals, with the autonomy to shape strategy and culture 
* Senior-level influence across clinical standards, operations, and commercial performance 
* Opportunities to lead large-scale change and drive long-term organisational impact 
* Funded learning and development, including access to inspiring vet care Academy training centres and senior leadership programmes 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into wider executive or group leadership roles 
 
 
What We Offer Our Team 
 
*6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays 
*Private medical insurance 
*Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
*Pension scheme 
*Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
*Retail discounts and cashback offers
*Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets  

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources. 
 
Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="elementToProof"> <p>Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.</p> </div></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Lead at the forefront of AI &amp; Data Resilience</em></strong></p> <p>At Veeam, we don’t just talk about the future of technology — we are actively shaping it. We are a global leader in data resilience, operating at the epicentre of the AI, cloud and security evolution. Our culture is built by forward-thinking technologists with heart: people who challenge convention, collaborate openly, and believe that great ideas can come from anywhere.</p> <p>Joining Veeam means being part of a business that combines the energy and agility of a start-up with the scale, credibility, and market leadership of a global technology powerhouse. We focus relentlessly on customer outcomes, empower our teams to own their destiny, and create an inclusive environment where every voice matters.</p> <p><strong><em>Why Veeam</em></strong></p> <p>Work at the heart of AI-driven data resilience, enjoy flexibility and outcome-based performance, and lead with autonomy in a globally recognized organization that invests deeply in its people, culture, and leadership.</p> <p><strong><em>The Opportunity</em></strong></p> <p>This is a pivotal growth role within Veeam’s UK &amp; Ireland organization.</p> <p>As Account Executive, Commercial Named you will be responsible for a book of existing key FTSE 100 &amp; 250 customers and a set of target private commercial named accounts to hunt and close net new logo acquisition. You will drive a daily rhythm to ensure in quarter execution and build forward pipeline. You will develop a clear point of view on the market and a constant curiosity to link corporate objectives and technology initiatives with customer and partners alike. You will set and manage the strategy for your Territory working with specialist teams in the UK &amp; Ireland and Inside Sales and Sales Development teams based in Bucharest.</p> <p>Reporting to the Director of Commercial Named, UK &amp; Ireland, you will play a central role in shaping how Veeam engages customers, partners, and the market — accelerating growth while building a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the vision for your UK &amp; Ireland Commercial Named Territory</li> <li>Coordinate virtual, geographically distributed teams</li> <li>Drive disciplined sales execution across the full Veeam portfolio</li> <li>Accelerate growth in hybrid cloud and cloud-native environments</li> <li>Build executive-level relationships with senior stakeholders</li> <li>Challenge the status quo with bold, innovative ideas</li> <li>Partner with Channel, Hyperscalers, and System Integrators</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>What Success Looks Like</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Sustained revenue growth and increased wallet share</li> <li>Strong operational excellence and predictable execution</li> <li>High-trust, high-performance sales culture</li> <li>Deep, long-term customer and partner relationships</li> <li>A future-ready, scalable Commercial Named Territory</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <p>You are a seasoned Commercial Named Sales Account Manager with presence, energy, and ambition.
